headline: Bring Kasa and Tapo into the local loop
intro: Control provisioned TP-Link Kasa and Tapo devices from Home Assistant over your local network. Switch plugs and lights, monitor supported energy sensors, and bring Tapo camera live views into your dashboards.
highlights: Control plugs, switches, bulbs, strips, vacuums, and supported hub devices
Track energy consumption when a device provides monitoring sensors
Enable Tapo camera live view with camera account credentials from the Tapo app

flow.title: From provisioned device to local control
stages: Set up the device in the Kasa or Tapo app
Add it to Home Assistant with its network address and required credentials
Control entities and receive updates over the local network
